leaves.name: faltingsLemma1DVR
leaves.doc: Faltings 1983, p. 350, Lemma 1: a homomorphism over the generic fibre of two semiabelian schemes with abelian generic fibres extends uniquely as a homomorphism. S = Spec O (normal), U = its generic point (dense open); semiabelian fibrewise over residue fields, torus geometric (not required split), as in the Def. on p. 350. The bridge faltingsLemma1DVR_models gives the printed fibre conditions for both models by isSemiabelianModelO_imp_faltingsDef, including the torus extension on the whole closed fibre, the common finite fibre dimension, and commutativity. The theorem jO_genericOpen identifies the dense open, and faltingsLemma1DVR_of_printed checks the specialization.
